clips.text: Sadler Farms: a three-hundred-acre waterfront development opportunity on Lake Wheeler, on the Tennessee River in North Alabama.

Held by one family for more than seventy years, the land combines mature forest, rolling open fields, and more than a mile of shoreline, with two natural coves, one suitable for a future community marina.
The property faces one of the widest stretches of Wheeler Lake, Alabama's second-largest reservoir.
It is fifteen minutes from Athens and its new high school, and twenty-five minutes from Huntsville, one of the fastest-growing cities in the country.
The landowners are seeking a development partner.
